property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always invokes the callee with the encoded selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) so a well-formed ABI-decoded call reaches the callee (the recorder sees decoded args); the mutant that uses call("") sends empty calldata (not the selector/encoded args) so a recorder that expects the selector will observe different calldata/decoding and thus the property is violated for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the call to use a low-level .call without selector encoding (call with empty data) causing different success/failure behavior from the callee.
